scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled financial-receivables report resolution through the real worker

criteria.description: The worker resolves the existing financial-receivables catalog entry through the financial-module source and maps exactly its sixteen output columns.
criteria.limitations: The contract is verified against the current repository catalog; complete external Vetus dynamic-executor parity remains open.

criteria.description: The persisted source uses explicit account-scoped joins and projection, validates status/search/date input, applies inclusive UTC report-date semantics with issuedAt fallback, rejects foreign rows and does not select or log owner documents or full source rows.
criteria.limitations: Local disposable PostgreSQL proves the query and tenant boundary; target runtime roles, ACLs, network policy and deployed RLS remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: The source and worker reject more than 10,000 rows, invalid persisted state, missing sources and unknown report ids before empty-success persistence; the one-shot process propagates scheduled failures with a non-zero exit code.
criteria.limitations: The continuous worker intentionally retains tick-and-continue behavior; this gate does not change broader retry policy.

criteria.description: Bootstrap composes the source and audit service for continuous and one-shot workers; a real two-account one-shot process persists exact executions and durable non-PII execution/export audit records while preserving delivery and retry paths.
criteria.limitations: The process uses disposable local PostgreSQL and controlled/mock email only; no external provider or target deployment is claimed.

criteria.description: Intentional RED history is retained and financial/worker tests, builds, typechecks, secrets, formatting and diff hygiene pass after the implementation and exit-code remediation.
criteria.limitations: The bounded checks do not replace full global coverage, remote CI, target operations or release acceptance.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only review inspected the final scoped implementation after all remediations and found no scoped Critical, High or Medium issue.
criteria.limitations: The final reviewer was static and did not run tests; executable evidence is recorded separately. The reviewer role attempt rejected by account policy is not treated as approval.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, strict Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: Global parity remains 4/11 verified, clinical parity 2/3 verified and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS / 3 WARN / 1 FAIL.

gaps: Disposable local PostgreSQL does not certify target TCP/RLS/FORCE-RLS, runtime roles, ACLs or production scale.
The final independent review was static and did not run tests, although the executable test evidence is green.

Other scheduled report families, provider delivery, distributed worker failure/observability, browser/accessibility, remote CI, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, operational LGPD and remaining parity are open.
Run-once failure exit behavior is now non-zero for scheduled tick failures; consumers that relied on zero for a failed report must adopt the explicit failure contract.
conditions: Keep this report read-only and sourced only from tenant-scoped persisted encounter financial facts.
Revalidate before changing report columns, lifecycle semantics, search/date policy, actor/audit behavior or adding another worker report family.
Do not infer target, production, provider, credential, parity, readiness or release authority from this local bounded result.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled financial-receivables report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only reversible financial-module/worker TDD implementation and disposable PostgreSQL/process verification of the existing read-only report. Exclude settlement, cash/journal/provider behavior, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing receivable lifecycle semantics, exposing additional PII, adding provider/target behavior or expanding to another report family.

next_action: Keep CVG-004 and the global program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL with promotion BLOCKED; select any next gap only through fresh scouting and a new implementation-ready authority.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to encounter receivable schema, entity joins, status or report columns
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/delivery, audit or one-shot exit semantics
Expansion beyond scheduled financial-receivables read resolution
